keyFeatures: Weekly check-in rating 8 key burnout indicators on a 0-4 severity scale
Tracks burnout risk over time with trend visualization to catch worsening patterns
Based on established burnout research covering emotional exhaustion, cynicism, and efficacy
Actionable recovery suggestions triggered when your score crosses risk thresholds
tips: Consistency matters more than perfection — a quick weekly check-in is far more valuable than an occasional deep review, because burnout creeps up gradually.
High scores in emotional exhaustion plus low scores in personal accomplishment is the classic burnout signature — watch both dimensions, not just overall stress.
